description: Queue a SHA-256 hash for Merkle-batch anchoring to Base mainnet (POST /v2/anchor, live service at x402.fairseal.io). Returns anchor_id + status_url; poll with fairseal_anchor_status until 'anchored' (typically ~60s). Auth: Bearer key (FAIRSEAL_API_KEY / FAIRSEAL_ANCHOR_API_KEY) or keyless x402 USDC micropayment (an HTTP 402 response carries machine-readable payment terms).

metadata.description: Optional metadata object stored with the submission

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the receipt/commitment to anchor

name: fairseal_anchor_submit
title: Anchor a hash on Base
